_source: Public fields of the real system/init event Claude Code 2.1.286 printed on 2026-10-01 for a technical-mode call of claude_session.py in a disposable TEMP fixture (run 20261001T040836159121Z-g1-8f083e). The cwd and session_id are placeholders the fake fills in; plugin paths were dropped and the long slash_commands/skills lists shortened. Nothing private is kept.

_observed_later_events: a top-level assistant event (parent_tool_use_id null, message.model claude-opus-5-5), a rate_limit_event, then a result event (subtype success, is_error false, num_turns 1, modelUsage keyed claude-opus-5-5, terminal_reason completed). The resumed call reported the same session id in every event.
